name: worlds: count-based stopping and keyed streams
mechanism: R12: n* = ceil(0.25 / mc_tolerance^2) finishing worlds per priceable player (contract.mc_worlds()); growth reads finishing counts only; lines with fewer carry insufficient_simulation; every line carries mc_bound = 0.5/sqrt(n_finished). R13: model.Streams — SplitMix64 finaliser over (game key, global world id, per-world draw counter); every draw an inverse transform (gamma via gammaincinv, Box-Muller normal, Gumbel); world offset per batch = worlds already run.
scope: product.simulate/price/lines_for; model.Streams, Table.draw, softmax_draw, gumbel_topk, categorical_draw, sample_gain, player_effects, defense_effect; contract CONTRACT gains mc_bound.

predictions.claim: batch invariance: running worlds 0..n-1 as one batch or as two batches (0..k-1, k..n-1) gives identical integer Y, finishing masks and team stats
predictions.measure: tests: simulate(..., W=n, offset=0) vs concat of (k,0) and (n-k,k)

predictions.claim: stopping never reads a p: worlds_grown depends on finishing counts and n* only
predictions.reject_if: price loop references p or mc_se

predictions.claim: no published line has n_finished_worlds < n*
predictions.reject_if: any such line with p not null

predictions.claim: real-run pricing time per game within 2x of revision 14 (inverse transforms cost more per draw; batches unchanged)

companion_checks: lines_priced + lines_declared unchanged in count from revision 14 on the same scope
rejection: any prediction fails -> restore revision 14 product.py/model.py draw sites; run log row records the lesson.
